mapKnowledge.definition: map knowledge = the four oracle functions; local perception (the current node's own neighbours, recognising the goal when adjacent) and experience-derived state are retained in every cell

training.text: cold training session WITHOUT the map (train seed, 1,500 calls); its export is the world's experience store

cells.name: N1
cells.role: no map, the world's whole persisted store from T (the PRIMARY treatment)

cells.name: N1E
cells.role: no map, only the episodes of the same store (secondary: component)

cells.name: N1Q
cells.role: no map, only the Q table of the same store (secondary: component)

cells.name: O0
cells.role: map, no experience (descriptive anchor: what the map provides)

worlds.configurations: accepted-configuration stream indices 1672..2031 from CONFIG_START; generated at the freeze milestone, not before

claim.text: Does the world's own experience store (trained without the map) raise legal goal reaches when the map oracles are disabled?
claim.estimand: E1 = E_w[ Y_w(N1) - Y_w(N0) ], Y = legal goal reaches per 1,500-call test session
claim.scope: the TOTAL effect of delivering the tested store (all eight persisted components of the world's own map-off training export, together) at the start of a map-off session, versus starting cold, under the same map-off procedure and test seed; it is not the causal contribution of any single component or learning mechanism

margin.rule: programme margin (PRODSEM, INTERACTION, C'); sensitivity reported at 15 and 30

decisionRule.NO_PRACTICAL_EFFECT: -delta < CI lower and CI upper < delta

secondary.text: non-graph resets and total resets, N1 - N0 (reported separately, never merged with E1)
within-session learning without the map: legal reaches in calls 750..1499 minus calls 0..749, in N0 (and N1)

multi-step goal direction (agent-blind measurement): downhill rate of LEGAL executed moves made at true distance >= 2, minus its chance rate (uniform over the current node's neighbours; descriptive, not a null), N1 vs N0
one-step goal entry: share of executions from a goal-adjacent node that enter the goal, N1 vs N0
components without the map: E_w[ Y_w(N1E) - Y_w(N0) ] (episodes only), E_w[ Y_w(N1Q) - Y_w(N0) ] (Q only), E_w[ Y_w(N1E) - Y_w(N1) ]
mechanism diagnostics: illegal executions, admitted non-graph candidates, goal-keyed Q entries, delivered store sizes

secondaryPolicy.adjustment: none (unadjusted percentile intervals, reported as estimates)
secondaryPolicy.status: exploratory: no secondary yields a label, a claim or a decision; with 28 unadjusted 95 % intervals about 1.4 are expected to exclude the true value by chance alone
secondaryPolicy.counted: S1 2 + S2 2 + S3 3 + S4 1 + S5 1 + S6 3 + byGoal 4 goals x 4 = 28

instruments.text: condition integrity (state P) in every session

zero oracle leakage: in every map-off session every oracle's EXECUTED count is 0 and every oracle's BLOCKED count is > 0 (each guard evidences itself); in O0 every executed count is > 0 and every blocked count is 0
store identity: N1 / N1E / N1Q start with exactly the declared components of the world's T export (hash-checked per component, all others empty); N0 and O0 start empty
pairing: one test seed and one configuration per world; T uses the world's training seed
training fidelity: T ran map-off, floor off, cold, 1,500 calls, and exported a parseable store
default-off neutrality, oracle-scope and call-graph audit (gate level); tree identity pinned at block level

store provenance: every relational entry of the world's T export is a lag-1 or lag-2 pair of T's own position sequence or a self pair of a visited node (provenance.mjs); checked before any test session

provenance.why: lag 1 = executed moves, goal credit over recentMemory, episode replay; lag 2 = the runtime's lagged credit (main.js prev = agentLast, current = next)

rules.worldExclusion: any of the world's six sessions fails after one retry (crash, incomplete run, condition-integrity violation, oracle leakage, store-delivery mismatch), or its T export fails the store construct or provenance check (I7) before any test session
rules.stopping: fixed: all 360 worlds x 6 sessions = 2,160; no interim analysis, no extension, no optional stopping, no outcome-based exclusion, one frozen analysis
rules.primaryOutcome: legal goal reaches per 1,500-call test session (a goal reset entered over a graph edge); non-graph and total resets reported separately
rules.scope: map knowledge = the four oracle functions; local perception (the current node's own neighbours, recognising the goal when adjacent) and experience-derived state are retained in every cell
rules.claims: E1 measures what the persisted experience store does without the map in the SAME world and goal it was trained on; it is not transfer, recall, planning or understanding
rules.recommendation: a result justifies only the next design decision (LEARN-1 attribution, or retiring the cognition claims); it changes no production code
rules.mapOffProcedure: map off removes the reachability filter, so more candidates can be admitted and every later liveRng() draw can shift; N0 and N1 run this SAME procedure with the SAME test seed, so the shift is part of the procedure both arms share, and E1 is the store effect under it
rules.mapOnContrasts: every contrast with O0 (S5) is descriptive: it bundles the oracle terms, the removed filter and the random-stream shift; no causal attribution to any single oracle
rules.residualMap: the store may describe the part of the graph T itself traversed (in the development worlds T executed 66-76 of 78 directed edges); I7 shows it describes nothing T did not traverse. LEARN-0 does not separate learning a map from experience from any other use of experience
rules.learnsLimit: A LEARNS_WITHOUT_MAP outcome may reflect experience-derived graph reconstruction and path-keyed Q-values; it does not demonstrate map-free spatial reasoning, abstract route planning, or cognition.

sizing.decision: n = 360 is a deliberately limited design: the programme rule fixed before any outcome, unchanged by the development mean; its operating characteristics are disclosed (DESIGN.md section 6)
sizing.rule: n >= ((z0.975 + z0.80) * SD / delta)^2, SD = development SD of the primary contrast inflated by 25 %
sizing.source: evidence/calib_learn0_rows.json (XFER-1 development worlds 0..29), recomputed by sizing.mjs; verification evidence/sizing_learn0.json (closed form + Monte Carlo through the analysis bootstrap)
